entities.name: Sahl ibn Bishr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sahl ibn Bishr al-Israili was a Jewish or Syriac Christian astrologer, astronomer and mathematician from Tabaristan. He was the father of Ali ibn Sahl the scientist and physician, who became a convert to Islam.
